mapper.select:
SELECT MO.MGMT_OFC_NO, MO.APT_CMPLEX_NO, MO.MGMT_OFC_NM, MO.MGMT_OFC_TELNO, MO.MGMT_OFC_EML, MO.MGMT_OFC_BANK_CD, MO.MGMT_OFC_ACNT_HLDR_NM, MO.MGMT_OFC_ACNT_NO, MO.USE_YN,
AC.APT_CMPLEX_NM, AC.SIDO_NM, AC.SIGUNGU_NM, AC.EMD_NM, AC.DOROJUSO, AC.UNIT_CNT, AC.DONG_CNT, AC.BLD_YR
FROM MEMBER MB INNER JOIN MANAGER M ON MB.USER_NO = M.USER_NO INNER JOIN MGMT_OFFICE MO ON M.MGMT_OFC_NO = MO.MGMT_OFC_NO INNER JOIN APT_COMPLEX AC ON MO.APT_CMPLEX_NO = AC.APT_CMPLEX_NO WHERE MB.USER_ID = #{userId} AND MO.USE_YN = 'Y'
